0022600024.text: The Phoenix Suns (1-2, 12th in the West and 2nd in the Pacific, 2 games back) host the Denver Nuggets (1-1, 7th in the West and 4th in the Northwest, 2 games back) in an Emirates NBA Cup West Group A game, with Phoenix 1-0 at home, 0-2 on the road, and coming off a loss while Denver won its most recent game. Phoenix is without Mark Williams (shoulder surgery) and Oso Ighodaro (oblique strain), and Denver is without Julian Strawther (knee sprain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Suns lost all three meetings in 2025-26, most recently 125-123 in Phoenix on March 24, 2026.
